candidates.buyer: Small associations, sports clubs, hunters' and veterans' groups, religious and community bodies in FBiH (and RS equivalents)
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.existing: Accountants and general bookkeeping firms (generic); no dedicated association-filing product seen
candidates.name: FBiH non-profit association filing and bookkeeping service (annual financial statements to FIA)
candidates.trigger: Annual financial reports for NPOs under FBiH accounting law (Sl. novine FBiH 15/21) and NPO rulebooks (Sl. novine FBiH 81/21); half-year reports also had about 1,400 missing (unija.com).
candidates.unchecked: Exact current deadlines and penalties; current number of non-filers; whether FIA e-filing is free and simple; competitor search in Bosnian not run (budget); RS and Brcko rules; how many associations are dormant.

candidates.buyer: Small property-management firms, building managers (upravnici zgrada) and condominium owners' boards
candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.existing: None seen; inspection bodies and lift service firms do the inspections themselves
candidates.name: Lift annual-inspection scheduler and records for building managers
candidates.trigger: Naredba o sigurnosti liftova (Sl. glasnik BiH 99/12) art. 24: owner must ensure regular technical inspection at least once a year; repeated reports of skipped inspections and a canton/federal inspection jurisdiction dispute.
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search not run; fines and enforcement strength; number of buildings with lifts; whether inspection bodies already send reminders; willingness to pay of unpaid etazni vlasnici boards. Boilers and pressure vessels not found.

candidates.buyer: Scrap/secondary raw material buyers, small collectors, vehicle dismantlers, small waste haulers in FBiH
candidates.name: Waste and secondary-raw-material small-business register and permit pack (FBiH)
candidates.trigger: FBiH draft Pravilnik o izdavanju dozvole za aktivnosti male privrede u upravljanju otpadom (July 2024 draft): accompanying waste list, permit procedure, data on generation and movement entered in the waste information system; plus older Zakon o sekundarnim sirovinama (35/98, 109/12) and Uredba o zbrinjavanju otpadnih vozila.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the rulebook was adopted and when it applies; whether the information system is free and online; carrier forms; RS equivalent; competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Gold and jewellery shops and used-gold buyers in RS (and FBiH hallmark users)
candidates.name: Precious-metal buyer and jeweller purchase register (RS draft law)
candidates.trigger: RS Government draft law on control of precious-metal items (Sept 2025) regulating buyers (otkupljivaci) and purchase of used items; FBiH law gives Zavod za mjeriteljstvo hallmarking and supervision.
candidates.unchecked: Adoption status and records duties of the RS draft; any purchase-register or AML duty; number of buyers; competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Licensed exchange offices (mjenjacnice) in RS and FBiH
candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
candidates.name: Licensed money changer compliance pack (RS AML/licence overhaul)
candidates.trigger: RS draft amendments to the Foreign Exchange Law (2024): licensing moves to the RS Banking Agency, stronger AML supervision; FBiH exchange agents need Ministry authorisation and yearly contract with a bank.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the draft passed; which reports are due; number of licensees; most changers work through bank contracts that may supply software.

candidates.buyer: Small van, courier and minibus operators doing international transport
candidates.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
candidates.existing: Tachograph download/analysis tools from fleet vendors exist generally; not searched for BiH
candidates.name: Smart-tachograph and driver-hours compliance for small van and bus operators (G2V2, 2.5-3.5 t)
candidates.trigger: Reported EU rule from July 2026 requiring smart tachographs on 2.5-3.5 t vans in international transport; BiH working-time law (Sl. glasnik BiH 48/10, 66/16); IDDEEA smart-tachograph system.
candidates.unchecked: I could not confirm the July 2026 rule; the fetch of paragraf 19052026 was a different article (Croatian visa for BiH drivers). Need source text, BiH applicability, and a competitor search. Close to K01 but a different buyer group (vans and tachograph downloads, not Schengen days).

candidates.buyer: Livestock traders, farms and market operators
candidates.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
candidates.existing: Not seen; entry is probably done by vets and the official station
candidates.name: Livestock trader and farm movement-record assistant (DBP)
candidates.trigger: State Pravilnik o obiljezavanju i kontroli kretanja zivotinja u BiH and the State Database (DBP): tagging deadlines, passports, movement register entries, registration of livestock markets.
candidates.unchecked: Who enters data (farmer or vet); whether the DBP has a free web portal; competitor search not run.

candidates.name: Beekeeper register and migratory-site paperwork
candidates.trigger: FBiH Pravilnik o pcelarstvu (Sl. novine FBiH 31/18): mandatory beekeeper/apiary register tied to RPG; migratory apiaries need approved sites and landowner consent.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the rules are enforced; beekeeper association role; low willingness to pay likely.

candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.name: Farm veterinary-drug treatment diary
candidates.trigger: FBiH rule: each treatment, drug and withdrawal period logged on a standard form, kept 3 years, shown to inspectors.
candidates.unchecked: Rule name, number and enforcement; whether the farm-register app already includes it.

candidates.buyer: Hunters' associations that hold hunting grounds in FBiH

candidates.name: Hunting-ground user (lovacko udruzenje) reporting
candidates.trigger: FBiH Zakon o lovstvu (Sl. novine FBiH 4/06) and Pravilnik o uvjetima gospodarenja lovistima: management plan, cull control, damage compensation.
candidates.unchecked: Actual report forms and deadlines; association IT habits; overlaps with the association filing candidate.

candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
candidates.name: Driving school record-keeping
candidates.trigger: Cantonal rulebook on control: inspectors check training contracts, mandatory records and staffing.
candidates.unchecked: Which canton, how the exam registration works, competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Employers and agents hiring foreign workers
candidates.known_note: Same buyer and duty as K04.
candidates.name: Foreign-worker permit lifecycle (draft FBiH foreigners-employment law, quota exemptions)
candidates.trigger: Draft FBiH law on employment of foreigners; RS Chamber 2025 request to drop quotas.

candidates.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
candidates.known_note: Relevant new fact for K01 and K07: a special visa for professional drivers could reduce the 90/180 pain. Not a new idea.
candidates.name: Croatian special visa for BiH professional drivers (supports Schengen planning)
candidates.trigger: Croatian Foreigners Act change (May 2026) opening special visas for professional drivers; BiH minister expects implementation within weeks.
candidates.unchecked: Nothing; not re-checked. This may weaken K01 (fewer day limits for drivers) or change its logic; flag for whoever revisits K01.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No search spent (budget went to registered-business categories). No register or duty for households as employers surfaced incidentally. Unverified.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: FBiH: Zakon o prikupljanju, proizvodnji i prometu sekundarnih sirovina (Sl. novine FBiH 35/98, 109/12) and Pravilnik o tehnickoj opremljenosti (3/00); cantonal decisions on technical-technological equipment (e.g. SBK 7/99); environmental permit for collection sites. FMOIT/FMOiT draft 'Pravilnik o izdavanju dozvole za aktivnosti male privrede u upravljanju otpadom' (July 2024, draft only) would add accompanying waste list and data entry in a waste information system. No federal metal-purchase register or police-notification rule found. Nothing confirmed beyond one weak lead.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Search for pawnshop (zalagaonica) / used-goods purchase register rules returned nothing relevant for BiH. Unverified, not rejected.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: FBiH Zakon o plemenitim metalima: Zavod za mjeriteljstvo hallmarks and supervises. RS: Vlada RS adopted a draft law on precious-metal items in Sept 2025 that regulates buyers (otkupljivaci) of used items; adoption status unverified. No purchase-register duty confirmed.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: FBiH Uredba o zbrinjavanju otpadnih vozila exists (FAOLEX lists it as not repealed) with collection, storage, transport and reporting duties; full text not read. Dismantler licensing and reporting details unverified.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: State-level Pravilnik o obiljezavanju i kontroli kretanja zivotinja u BiH and the State Database (DBP): cattle tagged within 20 days, passports travel with animals, every sheep/goat/pig movement is recorded in a register, livestock markets must be registered. Ties to known K05; trader/farm buyer group is different.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Food hygiene rules (Sl. glasnik BiH 4/13 and 103/12) follow EU 852/853/854/882 with HACCP duties; export-approval route is state-level. No transition deadline for small slaughterhouses found. Nothing new beyond general HACCP (generic).

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: FBiH Pravilnik o pcelarstvu (Sl. novine FBiH 31/18): mandatory Register of beekeepers and apiaries inside the farm register (RPG); migratory apiaries use pre-approved sites with landowner consent. Brcko draft law differed (2021). Low willingness to pay.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: FBiH rule requires farm treatment records (drug, withdrawal period) kept 3 years, and veterinary pharmacies have facility rules; state Law on Veterinary Medicine 2002. No e-register of vet drugs found. Related to K05.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: FBiH water permit (vodni akt) via water agency/canton; household wells treated differently. No annual abstraction-reporting duty confirmed for small users. Little found.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Only the FBiH small-business waste draft rulebook (2024) and old waste category rulebook (Sl. novine FBiH 9/05) surfaced; no carrier consignment-note or annual report form confirmed. See scrap/waste candidate.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifts: Naredba o sigurnosti liftova (Sl. glasnik BiH 99/12) art. 24: owner must ensure a regular technical inspection at least once a year; enforcement by cantonal inspection (jurisdiction dispute noted in Sarajevo Canton, 2019-2023). Boilers and pressure vessels: nothing found, unverified.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent. Village/municipal water systems not screened.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: One search found no FBiH text on spray diaries, adviser or dealer licences (results were Montenegro/Croatia). Unverified.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Draft FBiH foreigners-employment law (quota exemptions for deficit occupations) and 2025 RS chamber push to abolish permit quotas; private mediation agencies exist, not all registered. Same buyer and duty as known K04.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No BiH cemetery law or register found (results were Croatian). Municipal utility matter; unverified for BiH.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: FBiH: new NPO financial-reporting rulebooks (Sl. novine FBiH 81/21); FIA recorded 2,811 associations not filing for 2018 (2019 figure); FBiH accounting law 15/2021. Halal supervision not checked.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: BiH law on working time and tachographs (Sl. glasnik BiH 48/10, 66/16); IDDEEA runs the smart-tachograph PKI. Paragraf item says EU rules from July 2026 require smart tachographs on 2.5-3.5 t vans in international transport (not confirmed at source). Croatia's new Foreigners Act opens special visas for BiH professional drivers (May 2026), relevant to K01/K07. Taxi already K09.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers: FBiH exchange agents need Ministry authorisation and a contract with a bank (renewed yearly), supervised by FBiH Banking Agency; RS draft amendments (2024) move licensing to RS Banking Agency with stronger AML. Market traders not searched (fiscalization is K06/K10).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools: inspection checks records and contracts (cantonal rulebook), no e-system found. Hunting: FBiH Zakon o lovstvu 4/06, hunting-ground users (associations) must be registered and belong to a hunters' union; no report form found. Tattoo studios and nurseries not reached.
